steps.caption: Estimates
steps.narration: Let's write an estimate and send it to a client. Start on the Estimates page.

steps.caption: New estimate
steps.narration: Choose New estimate.

steps.caption: Step 1: pick the client
steps.narration: Step one is the client. Search by name, email or phone.

steps.caption: Dana Whitfield
steps.narration: We'll pick Dana Whitfield.

steps.caption: Step 2: search the price book
steps.chapter: Add work from the price book
steps.narration: Step two is the work. Search your price book for an item.

steps.caption: Add the item
steps.narration: Choose Add. The item comes in with its price and its scope of work.

steps.caption: Quantity
steps.narration: Set the quantity. This kitchen needs thirty square feet, and the total updates.

steps.caption: Price and wording can be changed
steps.narration: You can change the price and the wording for this job.

steps.caption: Review
steps.narration: When everything is in, choose Review.

steps.caption: Step 3: title
steps.narration: Give the estimate a title your client will recognise.

steps.caption: Check the total
steps.narration: Check the lines and the total.

steps.caption: Send estimate
steps.narration: Then choose Send estimate. The client gets an email with a private link.

steps.caption: Sent, with its number
steps.narration: The estimate now has a number, and it's marked as sent.

steps.caption: Open this estimate
steps.narration: Open it to see how it's doing.

steps.caption: Sent, opened, valid until
steps.narration: This line shows when it was sent, and whether the client has opened it yet.

steps.caption: Preview
steps.narration: Preview shows you the client's view, in a new tab.

steps.caption: The client's view
steps.narration: This is what your client sees after confirming their email. They approve the estimate by typing their full name.

steps.caption: Company details, work, total
steps.narration: Your company details are at the top, then the work and the total.

steps.caption: Back to the CRM
steps.narration: Back in the CRM, the estimate waits for the client's answer.

steps.caption: Menu: Estimates
steps.narration: You'll find Estimates in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to create and send an estimate | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of writing an estimate in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will pick a client, add work from the price book, set the quantity, review the total and send it. Then you will open the preview to see what the client sees before they approve.
